preconditions.description: Number of queries is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 50 for n, s, k in queries)
preconditions.description: Number of elements in each array is between 1 and 50.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= s <= 200 for n, s, k in queries)
preconditions.description: Sum of elements in each array is between 0 and 200.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= k <= 2000 for n, s, k in queries)
preconditions.description: Sum of absolute differences in each array is between 0 and 2000.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, list) and len(result) == n for result, n, s, k in zip(results, ns, ss, ks))
postconditions.description: Each result is a list of length n.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(result) == s for result, s in zip(results, ss))
postconditions.description: The sum of elements in each result equals s.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(abs(result[i] - result[j]) for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1, n)) == k for result, n, k in zip(results, ns, ks))
postconditions.description: The sum of absolute differences between each pair of elements in each result equals k.

postconditions.expression: all(all(isinstance(x, int) and x >= 0 for x in result) for result in results)
postconditions.description: All elements in each result are non-negative integers.

postconditions.expression: all(result == sorted(result) for result in results)

postconditions.description: No result is -1 unless no valid array exists.
